newsitem.title: UK: New ED&F Man funds gather $195 mln in assets.
newsitem.headline: New ED&F Man funds gather $195 mln in assets.

text.p: ED&F Man Investment Products said on Thursday that two new public funds had raised $195 million.
Man-IP 220 (Series 2), a fund which invests in futures along with a diversified hedge portfolio, raised $137 million.
Global Futures Fund VII, a diversified futures fund offered primarily to German investors, raised $58 million.
The two new funds brought ED&F Man Investment Product's total assets under management to more than $1.3 billion.
ED&F Man Investment Products is the fund management arm of ED&F Man Group, the international agricultural products and trading company. - James Saft, London newsroom +171 542 2734
